changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionScore') BEGIN CREATE TABLE api.ExecutionScore ( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, ItemNumber int NOT NULL, AssetUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, EffectiveDate date NOT NULL, ScoreType int NOT NULL, Score decimal(5, 3) NULL, RunDate datetime NULL,
IsValidAllocation bit NULL, IsValidAsset bit NULL,
AllocationUid uniqueidentifier NULL, ScoreUid uniqueidentifier NULL,
[Message] nvarchar(2500) NULL, Success bit NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_ApiExecutionScore PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( ExecutionID ASC, ItemNumber ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionScore_AssetUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionScore_AssetUid ON api.ExecutionScore ( AssetUid ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionScore_AllocationUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionScore_AllocationUid ON api.ExecutionScore ( AllocationUid ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionScore_ExecutionID_Success') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionScore_ExecutionID_Success ON api.ExecutionScore ( ExecutionID ASC, Success ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionMetric') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionMetric]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [MetricAssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] NOT NULL, [Result] [bit] NOT NULL, [IsValidAsset] [bit] NULL, [IsValidMetric] [bit] NULL, [IsValidMetricDate] [bit] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [IsValidAllocation] [bit] NULL, [Value] [decimal](5, 3) NULL, [RunDate] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionMetric] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionMetric_AssetUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionMetric_AssetUid] ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( [AssetUid] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionMetric_MetricAssetUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionMetric_MetricAssetUid] ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( [MetricAssetUid] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionMetric_Success') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionMetric_Success] ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( [Success] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionScore_AllocationUid') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionScore_AllocationUid] ON [api].[ExecutionScore] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionScore_ExecutionID_AllocationUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionScore_ExecutionID_AllocationUid] ON [api].[ExecutionScore] ( ExecutionID, [AllocationUid] ) END
alter table [api].[ExecutionScore] alter column ScoreType int null
changeSet.rollback:

IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionScore_AllocationUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionScore_AllocationUid] ON [api].[ExecutionScore] ( [AllocationUid] ) END
alter table [api].[ExecutionScore] alter column ScoreType int not null
